unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U19: Distinguish complaint limitation,appeal deposits,enforcement and mediation

payload.title: An appeal and a mediated resolution follow different records
payload.core_explanation_md:
A consumer file needs the exact order and proceeding before choosing an appeal route. The source distinguishes the District appeal period from the stated original-jurisdiction State/National appeal routes, and separately requires the prescribed payer deposit. Complaint limitation starts from the relevant cause of action; a late complaint needs the stated sufficient-cause and recorded-condonation decision.

Mediation is another process, supported by the designated cells and mediator records. Referral is not settlement. Finality, enforcement as the described decree-like order, and satisfaction are distinct events. An unpaid final order does not become satisfied merely because the case status says disposed.

self_check.prompt_text: Does disposed necessarily mean the ordered amount was paid?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Decision, finality, enforcement and satisfaction must be tracked separately.

payload.title: Compute a stipulated consumer appeal deposit
payload.core_explanation_md: Assume the relevant eligible appeal requires50% of the ordered payment and the order directs INR 286,000. Calculate the deposit only; appeal admissibility and fees are separate.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: Assume an otherwise eligible consumer appeal with a stipulated50% deposit on an ordered payment of INR 394,000. Calculate the deposit in exact INR; do not treat it as a refund or reduction of liability.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

payload.stem_md: A case is referred to a mediation cell, but no agreement is reached. What can be concluded solely from referral?

options.text_md: The bank liability is finally admitted
options.explanation_md: Referral alone is not an admission or adjudication.

options.text_md: Every ordered amount has been paid
The dispute entered the mediation process; settlement needs its own record
options.explanation_md: A process event and its result are distinct.

options.text_md: The complaint limitation is automatically waived forever
options.explanation_md: Referral does not establish unlimited procedural relief.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A process event and its result are distinct.
